This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## Commands

```bash
# Run all tests
go test -v -race ./...

# Run tests for a single package
go test -v -race ./pkg/convert/...
go test -v -race ./pkg/codegen/...

# Run a single test
go test -v -run TestName ./pkg/convert/...

# Regenerate all files in pkg/convert that are marked "DO NOT EDIT"
cd pkg/codegen && go generate
```

## Architecture

The module provides **lossless numeric type conversions** in Go and is split into two packages:

### `pkg/convert` — the public API

- **`convert.go`** — defines `SrcToDst[Src,Dst]` (typed converter function), `AnyToAny` (untyped variant), the package-level `registry`, sentinel errors (`ErrInvRange`, `ErrInvSafeRange`, `ErrFraction`, `ErrUnkConv`, etc.), and the `init()` that registers all built-in converters.
- **`convert_registry.go`** — `Registry`: a `reflect.Type`-keyed two-level map guarded by `sync.RWMutex`. `Register`/`Lookup` operate on the package-level registry; `RegisterConverter`/`LookupConverter` operate on a supplied `*Registry`.
- **`convert_wrapper.go`** — `wrapper` bridges the typed `SrcToDst[Src,Dst]` to the `AnyToAny` interface used internally by the registry.
- **`convert_error.go`** — `Error` struct with `Err`, `Src`, `Dst` fields; `ChangeErrDstName` patches alias names in errors.
- **Handwritten converters** — `bool_to_bool.go`, `string_to_duration.go`, `string_to_string.go`, `string_to_time.go`.
- **Generated files** — every other `*_to_*.go` and `any_to_*.go` file. These are generated by `pkg/codegen` and carry a `// Code generated by 00_generate_main.go. DO NOT EDIT.` header. Never edit them directly.
- **`AnyTo<Type>` functions** — each generated file contains a `typX reflect.TypeFor[X]()` package-level variable plus `AnyToX(value any, opts ...Option)` that dispatches through the registry.

### `pkg/codegen` — the code generator (not part of the public API)

- **`codegen.go`** — `ActionName` constants and the `Action` type. An `Action` describes one step in a conversion (e.g. `CheckOverflows`, `CastDirectly`).
- **`type.go`** — `Type` wraps reflection metadata for a numeric type. `ConvActions(target Type) []Action` is the core algorithm: given a source and destination type it returns the minimal ordered sequence of actions required for a safe, lossless conversion.
- **`value.go`** — `Value` carries a package path + name and renders to Go source code (used for constants like `math.MaxInt32`).
- **`helpers.go`** — `MinInteger`, `MaxInteger`, `MinSafeFloat`, `MaxSafeFloat` return `*Value` literals used in action data.
- **`code_block.go`** — `CodeBlock` is a named `text/template` with embedded import declarations. Template lines prefixed `import <path>` are extracted into `imps`; the rest form the code template rendered by `Render(w, indent, data)`.
- **`code_blocks.go`** — all template instances (`cbSrcToDstFuncDef`, `cbCondition`, `cbIsWhole`, etc.) declared as package-level vars.
- **`file.go`** — `file` assembles a complete Go source file (copyright header, `package` declaration, de-duplicated sorted imports, code buffer).
- **`gen_src_to_dst.go`** — `GenSrcToDst` generates `XToY(src X) (Y, error)` functions and their tabular tests by iterating `Type.ConvActions`.
- **`gen_any_to_dst.go`** — `GenAnyToDst` generates `AnyToY(value any, opts ...Option) (Y, error)` functions and their tests.
- **`00_generate.go`** — `//go:generate go run 00_generate_main.go` trigger.
- **`00_generate_main.go`** — `//go:build ignore` main program. Calls `generateNumericConverters` (all `X_to_Y` pairs) and `generateAnyToNumericConverters` (all `any_to_Y` files). `numericTypes()` defines the canonical type list including aliases (`byte`, `rune`, `time.Duration`).

### Key design invariants

- Every conversion is **lossless or an error** — no silent truncation or rounding.
- Float-to-integer conversions check for NaN, ±Inf, fractional part, and safe integer range.
- `byte` / `rune` / `time.Duration` are aliases over `uint8` / `int32` / `int64` respectively; the generator handles them via `Type.Alias(...)`.
- `internal/test/test.go` exposes `test.Type{}` used in generated tests to trigger `ErrUnkConv`.
